title: Realization of a compatible flat tower arrow diagram
statement: Given structural bounded-above flat towers and level maps supplied by the core construction, the towers admit the cone augmentation, quasi-isomorphic truncation maps, and homotopy-category compatibilities required by the compatible flat tower diagram theorem.

proof.text: Apply the unconditional arrow-diagram theorem. The legacy structural-core hypothesis is unused; all cone assembly and geometric input is supplied by the unconditional theorem.

proof_origin.place: Finite-piece bar input; source cone descent and comparison homotopies proved in Lean.
